all_candidates.topic: Should police tactics in student protests be more regulated?
all_candidates.news_anchor: An RAF personnel fired pellet rounds during student protests over the NEET paper leak at Jantar Mantar on July 27, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Does an education minister's resignation ensure exam reform?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India's education minister resigned on July 26, 2026, following widespread student protests over exam paper leaks.

all_candidates.topic: Should India implement a national anti-cheating exam law?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Centre plans to introduce the Public Examinations Bill 2026 in Parliament to combat exam malpractices.

all_candidates.topic: Should UPI ATM withdrawals count towards free transaction limits?
all_candidates.news_anchor: New banking rules effective April 1, 2026, include UPI ATM withdrawals in monthly free ATM transaction limits.

all_candidates.topic: Is mandatory 2FA for all UPI transactions an overreach?
all_candidates.news_anchor: RBI mandated Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) for every digital payment, including UPI, effective April 1, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Are "silent layoffs" a justifiable corporate practice?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Around 35,000 tech jobs in India could be eliminated this year through "silent layoffs" as companies prioritize productivity.

all_candidates.topic: Is Delhi's 2028 ICE two-wheeler ban too ambitious?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Delhi's EV Policy 2026, effective July 1, 2026, mandates a ban on new registrations of ICE two-wheelers from April 2028.

all_candidates.topic: Should new labour codes mandate a universal minimum wage?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India published four new Central Labour Rules for 2026, including the Code on Wages, but technical criteria are pending.

all_candidates.topic: Should E20 petrol be priced lower for consumers?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas clarified on July 10, 2026, that E20 petrol is currently costlier to produce than pure petrol.

all_candidates.topic: Should AI skill prioritization justify traditional tech layoffs?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India saw the second-highest AI-driven tech layoffs globally, yet demand for AI talent surged in the first half of 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should PF withdrawals via UPI be universally allowed?
all_candidates.news_anchor: EPFO completed a system upgrade by July 1, 2026, enabling PF withdrawals directly through UPI-linked bank accounts.

all_candidates.topic: Is doubling railway fines an effective deterrent to violations?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Indian Railways rolled out tougher enforcement measures by July 1, 2026, doubling minimum penalties for several offenses.

all_candidates.topic: Are stricter credit card perk rules justified by banks?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Several major banks revised credit card benefit terms effective July 2026, imposing stricter eligibility for premium perks.

all_candidates.topic: Should mandatory replacement of old commercial vehicles with EVs begin?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Delhi Cabinet approved the 'Parivartan' scheme on July 22, 2026, to replace old commercial vehicles with cleaner alternatives.

all_candidates.topic: Is it fair to exempt premium petrol from ethanol blending?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Centre clarified on July 23, 2026, that premium petrol will remain ethanol-free while E20 is the standard fuel.

all_candidates.topic: Is online training effective for NEP's inclusive education goals?
all_candidates.news_anchor: CBSE announced a 5-day online training program on NEP 2020's "Empowering SEDGs" from July 27-31, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should schools teach students to use offline messaging apps?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Students used Bitchat, a Bluetooth-based app, to communicate during mobile internet curbs at Delhi protests on July 23, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Will new GST compliance rules genuinely simplify business filing?
all_candidates.news_anchor: New GST compliance updates, including AATO functionalities and stricter GSTR-3B ITC locking, are effective from July 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should the government frequently overhaul tax administration for GST?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Indian government prepared a blueprint by July 20, 2026, for a major restructuring of CBEC for glitch-free GST rollout.

all_candidates.topic: Should India ease FDI rules for e-commerce exports further?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government relaxed FDI rules for e-commerce on July 24, 2026, allowing foreign-funded firms inventory-based models for exports.
